closure_work: Reconstruct one cumulative topology from the preserved Domain I candidate plus every validated Domain II-VI bounded candidate in exact source order.
Prove all 66 frozen requirement identities are present exactly once and the frozen requirement-set digest remains unchanged.
Prove every provisional subskill has one canonical frozen parent and one resolvable DECOMPOSES_TO path, with no duplicate or orphan subskills.
Prove every admitted PREREQUISITE endpoint resolves and the admitted prerequisite graph is acyclic.
Inventory every UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL dependency candidate exactly once; do not promote any candidate merely to make closure green.
Classify unresolved candidates as explicit follow-on evidence work rather than silently dropping them.
Keep all assessment targets UNBOUND and all learner/retention/transfer/workplace/psychometric/SME/certification evidence UNOBSERVED.
Run unchanged Validator 003 on the exact cumulative closure candidate and preserve exact hosted evidence.

closure_result_semantics.structural_closure_pass: Means the frozen 66-node topology is internally coherent, provenance-preserving and ready for bounded successor work.
does_not_mean: canonical hard-prerequisite admission for unresolved candidates

on_pass: Preserve the exact cumulative closure evidence, then select the smallest evidence-valid successor from unresolved-dependency adjudication and deterministic assessment-target binding without replaying completed source-domain population.
on_failure: Preserve valid population evidence, identify the first exact identity/provenance/endpoint/cycle/orphan defect, repair only the deterministic defect, and rerun on a new exact subject without inventing semantic authority.
